title: Sicilienne
identity: The four-page Hal Leonard-hosted preview is Schott's 1994 violin (or cello) and piano edition, ED11197, arranged by Samuel Dushkin. Its editorial note attributes the piece to Dushkin rather than Maria Theresia von Paradis, while the cover retains Paradis's name. This preview is not the saxophone arrangement; it supports the attribution and source-edition question only.

evidence.claim: Hal Leonard-hosted Schott preview identifies the source edition as violin or cello and piano, arranged by Samuel Dushkin, ED11197; the score pages are visibly marked preview.
Printed editorial note attributes the work to Samuel Dushkin rather than Maria Theresia von Paradis.
The saxophone work/arrangement remains a separate edition; the preview score itself shows a violin line and piano, not saxophone.

score_observations.observation: The preview is not saxophone notation. The violin/piano score begins Andantino in 6/8 with a soft melodic entrance above piano chords, then develops a longer violin line; no saxophone range or technique can be inferred from it.

collection_flag: Short transcription of a violin/keyboard work with contested authorship; exact saxophone edition and arranger vary.

score_links.description: Public Schott ED11197 violin/cello and piano preview inspected. It is an alternate/source instrumentation, not the saxophone arrangement.

gaps: No saxophone arrangement score or recording was inspected; do not transfer the violin/cello line's demands to saxophone.
The work's authorship is disputed in the publisher note; saxophone arrangement identity and editorial basis need direct checking.
proposed_corrections: Qualify composer attribution as disputed and include Samuel Dushkin as a proposed composer.
